Make navigation and library browsing more compact.

- Click the LokTube logo and title in the top-left header to return to Home in the current tab. The branding is keyboard-accessible and the remaining window header stays draggable.
- Rename the History page heading to **History** and the Shorts section to **Shorts**.
- Hide or show the Shorts history strip from its section header. The choice persists in application preferences across restarts without deleting watch history, and pagination and individual removal still work.
- Replace text-heavy Remove buttons below watched videos and Shorts with a trash icon directly over each thumbnail. It appears on hover, keyboard focus and touch devices; authenticated YouTube history removal and its error handling are retained.
- Display subscribed channels in a compact, horizontally scrollable strip by default, with an option to expand the complete list and collapse it again. The choice persists.
- Retain 1.1.5 improvements for music artwork quality, optional video comments and Windows media controls.

Windows x64 and Linux x64 (AppImage/DEB) installers include source and automatic-update metadata. Windows installers remain unsigned.
